title: Made 3 Pokemon fan games with Claude Code, here’s how you can make your own
author: Western_Ad_418
selftext:
So I’ve been making Pokemon fan games with Claude Code doing basically all the coding, and a few people asked how, so here’s the simple version.

Don’t try to make a whole Pokemon game. Pick one idea. One of mine is just real-time battles, one is 4 people hunting a legendary together, and one you don’t even battle, you just try to keep a route’s Pokemon alive for a year.

Make it a browser game. I used Vite + TypeScript + canvas. People can play it without downloading anything and you can throw it straight on itch.

Don’t use AI for the Pokemon art. There’s tons of fan-made stuff already, like the PMD Sprite Collab sprites and HGSS tilesets. Just credit the artists.

Get something playable fast and actually play it. Then tell it what’s wrong like a player would. Stuff like “the Pokemon are standing on trees” or “this is way too easy”. You don’t need to know the code.

Make it test its own stuff. I had it make a bot that plays the whole game and fails if you can win by being lazy (my first version you could beat by planting 2 berry bushes lol). And another check that goes through every screen looking for text that’s too small or overlapping. Saved me so much time.

Put it on itch for free. Say it’s a fan game and not affiliated with Nintendo, and don’t charge for it.

You can play all 3 free here: [https://clydejuniorscripts.itch.io](https://clydejuniorscripts.itch.io)

Ask me anything if you’re trying to make one.
